selector.why: The combination of a diffusely enhancing lesion on MRI and an expansile bony lesion on CT with no evidence of primary malignancy elsewhere decided it.

support_spans: Contrast-enhanced MRI of the thoracic spine demonstrated a diffusely enhancing lesion centered at T1 with near-circumferential epidural extension causing severe cord compression
CT of the thoracic spine showed an expansile bony lesion of the T1 vertebral body with extension into the left pedicle and posterior elements
